name: cruscotto
description: Instrument strip above the prompt: context, 5-hour and weekly limits, range to the reset, a tokens-per-minute meter, the last turns, the session's tokens and cost, four lamps and prompt buttons.

skin.title: Skin
skin.description: The look of the strip: night (dark themes), amber (one-color amber cluster), paper (light themes) or mono.

warnAt.title: Amber threshold (%)
warnAt.description: A quota bar turns amber when this share of its window or less is left.

badAt.title: Red threshold (%)
badAt.description: A quota bar turns red when this share of its window or less is left.

lamps.title: Lamps
lamps.description: Show the four lamps on the bottom row: failed turn, cold cache, tools running, agents running.

coldCacheBelow.title: Cold cache lamp (%)
coldCacheBelow.description: The cold lamp lights amber when the cache hit of the last turn is under this share.

heavyStartAt.title: Heavy start (%)
heavyStartAt.description: The heavy lamp lights amber when the first context reading of a conversation is at or above this share: the fixed load of instructions, skills and tools.

buttons.title: Prompt buttons
buttons.description: Show the three built-in prompt buttons.

buttonsFile.title: Your buttons
buttonsFile.description: A Markdown file with your own buttons: each `## Label` heading starts one, the lines under it are the prompt it sends. Hotkeys 1 to 9 in order.
